battle.name: 徐河之戰
battle.brief: 端拱二年（989）六月，遼將耶律休哥率精銳數萬騎入寇，圖襲遂城宋威虜軍；宋廷命李繼隆率鎮定大軍護送軍糧數千乘北上。尹繼倫部千餘人巡塞上遇之，遼軍不擊而直撲糧隊；尹繼倫乘夜銜枚追至徐河城北，待遼軍會食，短兵突擊，殺其大將，耶律休哥負臂遁走。卡面埃及長矛為青銅守城之矛，不在此役現場。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰一方是北宋朝廷與河北邊軍，另一方是遼朝的南京方面。宋太宗端拱二年坐鎮開封，詔令保順軍節度使、侍衛親軍司馬軍都指揮使、定州路都部署李繼隆，發鎮州與定州兩地大軍護送軍糧數千乘北上，救援糧草不繼的威虜軍；前線的威虜軍治所在河北遂城，歸定州路都部署節制。宋的兵制以禁軍為骨幹，侍衛親軍司分為馬軍、步軍兩司，殿前司另領部分人馬，地方則由節度使、觀察使、都部署、部署、都虞候一級的軍職分掌城鎮與巡檢；出巡塞上的北面緣邊都巡檢使尹繼倫領步騎千餘人，隸洛苑使職名之下。遼方由宿將耶律休哥（遼封裕悅）率精銳數萬騎自北方南下，遼以南京統軍、宿衛與諸路蕃漢兵為骨幹，騎兵是突進的先鋒，漢人、渤海兵亦編入同樣的序列。兩軍在河北徐河、曹河一線正面接戰，沒有第三方介入，也沒有外交折衷的餘地。
countriesEn: One side was the Northern Song court with its Hebei frontier commands, the other the Liao dynasty acting from its southern capital. In the second year of Duan'gong Emperor Taizong Zhao Guangyi, enthroned in Kaifeng, ordered Li Jilong — military governor of Baoshun Army, commander of the cavalry office of the Palace Guards, and regional commander of Dingzhou — to move troops from Zhenzhou and Dingzhou with several thousand cartloads of grain to relieve the Weilü Army, whose supply at its garrison in Suicheng in Hebei had run short. The Weilü Army, whose headquarters stood at Suicheng, answered to the regional commander of Dingzhou. The Song military system rested on the elite imperial guards: the Palace Guards were split into a cavalry and an infantry office, the Palace Command held further contingents, and the provinces carried a ladder of posts — military governor, circuit intendant, regional commander, deputy commander and deputy garrison commander — responsible for walled towns and for patrol duty. Yin Jilun, inspector of the northern frontier, led more than a thousand foot and horse on patrol under the title of magistrate of Luoyuan. On the Liao side the veteran general Yelü Xiuge, honoured by the Liao as Yuyue, led several tens of thousands of elite riders south from the north. Liao field power drew on the troops of the southern capital, the imperial guards and the native and Han contingents of the various circuits, with cavalry as the spearhead; Han Chinese and Bohai soldiers were folded into the same order of battle. The two armies met in earnest along the Xu and Cao rivers in Hebei, with no third party involved and no room for a diplomatic compromise.
people: 尹繼倫是此役真正決定勝負的人，出身浚儀，官洛苑使、充北面緣邊都巡檢使，領步騎千餘人按行塞上。遇耶律休哥的數萬精騎時，遼軍視他如無物，不擊而徑撲李繼隆的運糧大軍。尹繼倫隨即對麾下直言：遼軍把我等視為魚肉，若其得手，回程必乘勝把我北驅；若其不勝，也會把一腔怒氣發在我們頭上，士卒無一能活；與其坐以待斃，不如當日捲甲銜枚襲其背後。將士皆激奮從命。他當夜遣人持短兵潛隨遼軍之後，疾行數十里至唐州徐河，天未明時列陣城北，待遼軍會食，突然出擊，殺其大將一人，擾亂全軍。遼軍主帥耶律休哥飯未吃完便棄匕箸奔逃，被短兵重創手臂，創甚，靠善馬選脫；餘部望見李繼隆大軍趕到當即潰散，自相蹂踐。另一線上，孔守正部在曹河附近斜村與遼軍鏖戰，斬其將大盈。事後因尹繼倫面色黑，遼軍內部傳出「小心黑臉大王」的說法；朝廷授他領長州刺史，他仍照舊巡檢邊境。李繼隆、范廷召追奔過徐河十餘里，俘獲甚眾。
peopleEn: Yin Jilun was the man who actually decided the day. A native of Junyi, he held the office of magistrate of Luoyuan and served as inspector of the northern frontier, commanding more than a thousand foot and horse as he patrolled the border line. When Yelü Xiuge's tens of thousands of elite riders came up, the Liao ignored him and pressed straight at the grain convoy led by Li Jilong. Yin at once told his men plainly that the Liao treated them as fish and meat: should the raiders win, they would return on the momentum of that success and drive the Song north; should they lose, they would discharge their anger on the Song, and not one soldier would escape alive. Better, he argued, to fold the armour, hold the mouthpiece shut and strike the enemy's rear that same day. The soldiers, roused and angry, obeyed. That night he sent men with short weapons to shadow the Liao trail, marched dozens of li in darkness, and by the Xu River of Tangzhou, before dawn, drew up north of the walled town to wait; when the Liao sat down to eat, he struck without warning and killed one of their senior generals, throwing the whole force into confusion. Yelü Xiuge, the Liao commander, abandoned his meal before it was finished, threw down his spoon and chopsticks and ran, taking a severe wound in the arm from a short weapon, and escaped on a fast horse; the rest, seeing Li Jilong's host arrive, broke at once and trampled each other in the rout. On another part of the field Kong Shuzheng's command fought the Liao hard at Xiecun near Caohe and beheaded their general Daying. Afterwards, because Yin was dark-complexioned, the Liao whispered among themselves to beware of the 'black-faced king'. The court granted him the governorship of Changzhou, and he went on patrolling the border as before. Li Jilong and Fan Tingzhao pursued beyond the Xu River for more than ten li and took very many prisoners.
kits: 卡面這柄埃及長矛，是早王朝時期以銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上的制式長矛，埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。它在本役的對位，是宋代步兵裝備的骨幹：端拱二年禁軍與邊軍的步戰，靠的正是長槍（矛）配合刀與弓箭構成的近身戰鬥力，卡面所繪的長矛因此可以視為宋軍陣中每一個什伍的標準配備，也是「守城垣」那一面——徐河城北的列陣，靠的就是這類長兵器在夜色中撐住的陣腳。真正的分野在夜襲：尹繼倫部依計畫捲甲銜枚，人人手持短兵，把長兵器留在營中，改以短兵突擊正在會食的遼軍隊列，近身使遼軍騎兵來不及展開衝鋒。遼軍自身以騎弓、環首刀、狼牙棒以及札甲、鏈子甲為主，缺的正是能與短兵相抗的近身器械。糧秣方面，宋軍以數千乘太平車、大車裝載軍糧，由騾馬挽曳，護送兵種為步騎混合；本役屬野戰攔截而非攻城，雙方均未使用撞竿、雲梯一類攻城器械，也沒有砲陣與壕壘，勝負完全落在裝備的運用時機與糧秣、箭矢的保存上。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is an Egyptian spear of the early dynastic period, a standard long weapon with a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft; the Egyptians used it to hold city walls, and later to recover lost ground. Its counterpart in this battle is the backbone of Song infantry equipment. In the second year of Duan'gong the foot soldiers of the imperial guards and the frontier levies fought chiefly on long spears and pikes working together with sabres and bows, so the spear on the card can be read as the standard issue of every squad in the Song line — and it is also the 'holding the wall' side of the weapon: the line drawn up north of the walled town of Xu River was a formation kept in place by exactly such long weapons in the dark. The real divide on the night lay in the assault. Following the plan, Yin Jilun's men folded their armour, held their tongues and left their long weapons behind, taking only short weapons as they struck the Liao while the enemy was still at its meal; at close quarters the Liao cavalry had no time to form a charge. The Liao in turn relied on mounted bows, ring-pommel sabres, clubs, and lamellar and mail armour, and they lacked precisely the close-combat tools that could answer short weapons. For supply, the Song loaded grain onto several thousand flat and heavy wagons drawn by mules and horses, guarded by a mixed force of foot and horse. The engagement was an open-country interception rather than a siege: neither side employed rams, ladders or any other siege engine, there were no artillery parks and no trenches, and the result turned entirely on the timing with which equipment was used and on whether the grain and arrows were preserved.
tactics: 遼軍的戰法是典型的草原式掠糧奔襲：得知宋威虜軍糧草不繼，便以數萬精騎直趨河北遂城，要在宋軍最空虛的時候奪取軍營與糧秣，騎兵的速度本身就是戰術核心。尹繼倫部行至塞上與遼軍遭遇，遼軍不加攻擊，直撲李繼隆的運糧大隊，把這支部隊留在自己身後。尹繼倫據此判斷，與其坐等遼軍奪糧後回身驅趕，不如主動追擊：當夜全軍捲甲銜枚、棄長持短，遣斥候探知遼軍去路，銜尾跟行數十里，至唐州徐河，趨近天明時列陣於徐河城北待機。遼軍會食未竟，宋軍以短兵突然發起襲擊，殺其大將，驚散其陣；此際李繼隆、范廷召率鎮、定大軍及護糧車隊趕到，遼軍前後受敵，頓時潰散，自相蹂踐。宋軍隨即自徐河追奔十餘里，收捕散卒與輜重。同一時間，孔守正部在曹河附近斜村與另一支遼軍鏖戰，斬其將大盈，兩處戰場相互策應，把遼軍這次入寇的鋒芒完全壓住。守方則以車隊為核心，護騎步兵夾護，車隊不離大路，行止皆與前哨保持聯繫。
tacticsEn: The Liao plan was a grassland raid for grain. Learning that the Song Weilü Army was short of supplies, they rode with several tens of thousands of elite cavalry straight for Suicheng in Hebei, meaning to seize the camp and its stores at the moment when the Song position was hollow; the speed of the mounted arm was itself the tactic. When Yin Jilun's column met them on the border, the Liao did not even engage it but pressed on to Li Jilong's convoy, leaving that column behind their backs. Yin judged from this that rather than wait to be driven north by a victorious raider, the Song should attack first: that night the whole column folded its armour and held its tongues, gave up long weapons for short ones, sent out scouts to find the Liao track, followed them for dozens of li, and before dawn drew up north of the walled town of the Xu River to wait. The Liao had not finished eating when the Song struck with short weapons, killed a general and shook the formation; at that moment Li Jilong and Fan Tingzhao arrived with the Zhenzhou and Dingzhou troops and the grain carts, and the Liao, caught front and rear, broke in an instant and trampled each other in the rout. The Song then pursued beyond the Xu River for more than ten li, gathering stragglers and booty. At the same hour Kong Shuzheng's command fought another Liao detachment to a standstill at Xiecun near Caohe and beheaded their general Daying; the two fields of battle supported one another and blunted the whole thrust of the Liao incursion. On the defending side the formation turned on the wagon train, with horse and foot closing around it, the carts never leaving the main road and every halt kept in touch with the outposts ahead.
data: 可核的數字大致如下：時間為端拱二年（989）六月；遼軍主攻兵力記載為「精銳數萬騎」，宋方尹繼倫部為「步騎千餘人」，李繼隆所發鎮州、定州大軍人數史無詳。糧秣方面，護送的軍糧為「數千乘」，達上百車的規模；威虜軍駐地遂城在今河北徐水縣以西二十五里，徐河在今徐水縣南，斜村在曹河附近。距離上，遼軍會食之地距運糧大軍尚有四五里，尹繼倫尾隨遜行數十里，宋軍追擊越過徐河十餘里。戰果方面，記載只說宋軍殺遼軍大將一人、斬曹河斜村遼將大盈、俘獲甚眾、遼軍自相蹂踐死者無數，並無雙方確切傷亡數字，本篇不替史書補造數字。戰後朝廷授尹繼倫領長州刺史，遼軍此後數年不再南下。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. The date is the sixth month of the second year of Duan'gong, 989. The Liao striking force is recorded as 'several tens of thousands of elite riders'; on the Song side Yin Jilun commanded 'more than a thousand foot and horse', while the size of the Zhenzhou and Dingzhou host sent by Li Jilong is not stated. As for supply, the escorted grain amounted to 'several thousand cartloads', on a scale of hundreds of wagons. The Weilü Army's garrison at Suicheng lay twenty-five li west of present-day Xushui county in Hebei, the Xu River ran to the south of that county, and Xiecun lay near Caohe. On distances: the place where the Liao were eating was still four or five li from the grain convoy; Yin Jilun shadowed the enemy for dozens of li; the Song pursuit carried beyond the Xu River for more than ten li. As to results, the sources record only that the Song killed one Liao general, beheaded Daying at Xiecun near Caohe, took very many prisoners, and that the Liao died in great numbers from trampling each other in the rout; no exact casualty figures exist for either side, and this account will not invent any. After the war the court appointed Yin Jilun military governor of Changzhou, and the Liao did not come south again for several years.
cause: 直接起因是糧草。唐河之戰後宋遼邊境一度平靜，端拱二年六月宋威虜軍（治河北遂城）糧草不繼，駐地空虛，遼軍得到情報，準備趁隙攻取。李繼隆奉詔發鎮、定二州大軍護送軍糧前往，徐河之戰因此爆發。但真正的裂口在接戰之後：遼軍數萬精騎在塞上遇到尹繼倫所領的千餘步騎，卻不戰而過，直撲李繼隆的運糧大軍，把尹繼倫部留在身後。尹繼倫隨即指出，遼軍把我等視為魚肉，若其得手，回程必乘勝把我北驅；若其不勝，也會把一腔怒氣發泄在我們身上，士卒將無一倖免；與其坐以待斃，不如當日捲甲銜枚襲其背後，趁其銳氣前趨不虞我至而力戰，縱然不勝也還不失忠義。將士皆激奮從命，遂有這場以弱擊強的夜襲。深層原因則是宋遼在河北邊境爭奪燕雲十六州的持久對峙：遼以掠取邊軍糧秣、削弱宋的守備為長期手段，宋則要保住通往前線的補給線，雙方對這條線的爭奪才是本役的真正導火線。
causeEn: The immediate cause was grain. After the fighting at Tanghe the Song-Liao frontier was briefly calm, and in the sixth month of 989 the Weilü Army, garrisoned at Suicheng in Hebei, was running out of supplies with its position left hollow; the Liao learned of this and prepared to seize the opportunity. Li Jilong was ordered to move Zhenzhou and Dingzhou troops with a grain convoy, and the battle at the Xu River followed. The real breach, though, came after the armies met: several tens of thousands of Liao elite riders ran into Yin's thousand-odd foot and horse on the border and rode past them without a blow, plunging at Li Jilong's convoy and leaving Yin behind their backs. Yin immediately pointed out that the Liao treated them as fish and meat: if the raiders won, they would return on the strength of that success and drive the Song north; if they lost, they would discharge their anger on the Song, and no soldier would survive. Better to be killed in the attack than to sit and wait for death, so they should fold their armour, hold their tongues and strike the enemy's rear while his momentum carried him forward and he did not expect them; fighting hard and winning would be enough to make a name for themselves, and even losing would not cost them their loyalty. Roused and angry, the soldiers obeyed, and the night attack that carried a weaker force against a much stronger one grew out of that reasoning. Beneath the immediate cause lay the long confrontation between Song and Liao over the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun: the Liao habitually took frontier stores to weaken the Song garrisons, and the Song was determined to keep the supply route to the front alive, and that route was the true fuse of this war.
impact: 此役的影響，最直接的落在邊疆上：遼軍偷襲不成反被偷襲，精銳數萬騎遭突擊潰散，自相蹂踐，又被宋軍追奔十餘里、俘獲甚眾，士氣大挫，此後數年都不曾再南下。宋軍方面，運糧隊與威虜軍的補給線安然無恙，河北邊防的糧秣壓力解除；尹繼倫以千餘人破敵數萬騎，一戰成名，遼人因他面色黑而傳出「小心黑臉大王」的話，朝廷隨後授他領長州刺史，他仍照舊巡檢邊境。放到更長的戰線看，這場勝利並未改變宋遼在燕雲十六州的根本態勢，遼軍退回北方，宋朝也沒有因此收復一寸失地；但它證明了宋軍邊軍在主動出擊、奇襲與夜戰上的戰力，讓北伐之議在軍中第一次有了實據，也讓河北防務從純粹的守禦轉為守中帶攻。此後宋遼之間維持了十餘年的相持局面，直至景德元年再起大規模戰事。
impactEn: The most direct consequences fell on the frontier. The Liao raid, intended as a surprise, was itself surprised: several tens of thousands of elite riders were thrown into confusion by the night attack, trampled one another in the rout, were chased for more than ten li and lost very many prisoners to captivity, and their morale was badly shaken, so that for several years they did not cross south again. On the Song side the grain convoy and the supply line of the Weilü Army came through intact and the pressure on the Hebei garrisons eased. Yin Jilun, who had broken an enemy many times his own strength with barely more than a thousand men, became famous overnight; because he was dark-complexioned the Liao spoke of the 'black-faced king', and the court granted him the post of military governor of Changzhou, though he carried on with border patrol as before. Viewed along the longer front, the victory changed nothing fundamental in the Liao-Song balance over the Sixteen Prefectures: the Liao withdrew to the north and the Song recovered not an inch of lost territory. What it did prove was that Song frontier troops could strike out on their own, mount a surprise attack and fight a night action, and it gave the cause of a northern campaign in the army its first hard evidence, while shifting the Hebei defence from pure sitting-to-defend towards defence with the initiative. Between the two states there followed more than a decade of stalemate, until large-scale war broke out again in the first year of the Jingde era.
result: 結果是遼軍戰敗。宋軍在徐河城北以短兵夜襲遼軍會食之陣，殺其大將一人，驚動全軍；耶律休哥丟下匕箸奔逃，手臂為短兵所創，傷勢頗重，乘善馬逸去。餘部望見李繼隆、范廷召所領的鎮、定大軍趕到，當場潰散，爭相逃命，自相踩踏死者無數；宋軍追奔過徐河十餘里，俘獲甚眾。曹河附近斜村一線，孔守正部與遼軍鏖戰，斬遼將大盈，等於斷了遼軍另一翼的臂膀。遼軍此次入寇既未奪得遂城，也沒能截走糧車，遂全線退出宋境，數年之間不再南下。宋軍護糧任務完成，威虜軍糧草得濟，河北前線的守備恢復常態；尹繼倫因功授領長州刺史，卻沒有因此升遷離開巡檢崗位，仍然往來於塞上。
resultEn: The result was a Liao defeat. The Song struck the Liao while they were still at their meal, north of the walled town of the Xu River, with short weapons, killing one of their senior generals and throwing the whole force into confusion. Yelü Xiuge threw down his spoon and chopsticks and ran, taking a heavy wound in the arm from a short blade, and left on a fast horse. The rest of the Liao, seeing Li Jilong and Fan Tingzhao arrive with the Zhenzhou and Dingzhou host, broke instantly, and in the scramble for escape trampled each other to death in great numbers; the Song pursued beyond the Xu River for more than ten li and took very many prisoners. On the Caohe front at Xiecun, Kong Shuzheng's troops fought the Liao hard and beheaded their general Daying, which cut off the other wing of the incursion. The Liao took neither Suicheng nor the grain carts, and withdrew from Song territory entirely, not coming south again for several years. The escort duty was accomplished, the Weilü Army's stores were replenished, and the Hebei front returned to its normal watch. Yin Jilun was granted the governorship of Changzhou for his part, but was not promoted away from his patrol, still riding up and down the border line.
